title: Seven Voices Binary Structural Projection Experiment v0.1

byConstructionProperties: the seven Voices occupy the seven nonzero codes
the first two bits encode the ring ordinal 0,1,2,3 for O, I/U, E/Y, A/Ë
each non-self mirror pair differs only in the least-significant bit
A↔Ë, E↔Y, and I↔U each have Hamming distance 1
each non-self mirror pair XORs to 001, the code assigned to O
O is a self-mirror exception and is not represented as an ordinary binary edge
the code sequence is fixed by the selected construction

implications: 000 is the graph/vector origin for mathematical calculations but has no Voice semantics
Hamming weight is distance from the experimental sentinel, not a canonical ring value
the canonical structural center remains O at 001
fixing 000 removes the translation freedom from the selected mapping universe
the chosen bit labels are a representation convention and are not semantic claims
isomorphismNotes: allowing any unused cube vertex would produce 8*7! labeled assignments
the fixed-sentinel universe uses one representative convention with 7! assignments
a different unused vertex is mathematically cube-isomorphic only after transforming the complete code labeling
no sentinel choice receives semantic interpretation in v0.1

mappingUniverse.definition: bijections from the seven canonical Voices to the seven nonzero 3-bit codes with 000 fixed as unused

controlFamilies.name: UNRESTRICTED
controlFamilies.formalPredicate: every bijection in the fixed-sentinel universe

controlFamilies.name: MIRROR_EDGE_PRESERVING
controlFamilies.formalPredicate: Hamming(code(a),code(b)) = 1 for (a,b) in (A,Ë),(E,Y),(I,U); O has no ordinary edge requirement
controlFamilies.relation: contains CENTERED_MIRROR_EDGE; O self-mirror is excluded from edge counting

controlFamilies.name: PAIR_BLOCK_PRESERVING
controlFamilies.formalPredicate: each non-self mirror pair has equal first-two-bit block; with 000 excluded this forces O=001
controlFamilies.relation: subset of CENTERED_MIRROR_EDGE; exact ring blocks may be permuted

controlFamilies.name: EXACT_RING_PRESERVING
controlFamilies.formalPredicate: binaryValue(code(v)[0:2]) = canonical ring(v) for every Voice v

controlFamilies.name: STRUCTURAL_V0_1
controlFamilies.formalPredicate: code(v) equals the frozen mapping for every Voice v

mirrorEdgeDefinition.meaning: literal Hamming-cube adjacency for the three non-self mirror pairs

ringDefinition.observable: integer value of the first two bits
ringDefinition.center: O is ring 0 and code 001; sentinel 000 is not the center Voice

metricEquivalence.comparisonRule: raw deterministic signatures are counted within each control family; candidate uniqueness is reported but is not by itself additive evidence

metrics.name: code_sequence
metrics.invariance: none under nontrivial fixed-label code relabeling

metrics.name: pairwise_hamming_distance_matrix
metrics.definition: upper-triangular pairwise Hamming distances in canonical Voice order
metrics.invariance: Hamming-cube automorphisms; fixed-sentinel subgroup is coordinate permutations

metrics.name: pairwise_xor_matrix
metrics.definition: upper-triangular pairwise XOR vectors in canonical Voice order
metrics.invariance: translation-invariant; vector values transform under GL(3,2)

metrics.name: ordered_xor_transition_signature
metrics.invariance: translation-invariant; raw vector labels are GL(3,2)-orientation-sensitive

metrics.name: hamming_weight_sequence
metrics.definition: Hamming weight in canonical Voice order
metrics.invariance: coordinate-permutation invariant; not invariant to bit flips

metrics.name: hamming_transition_signature
metrics.definition: consecutive Hamming distances across canonical Voice order

metrics.name: cube_edge_incidence
metrics.definition: whether every canonical Voice pair is a literal Hamming-1 edge

metrics.name: distance_to_center_sequence
metrics.definition: Hamming distance from each code to code(O), in canonical Voice order
metrics.invariance: Hamming-cube automorphism invariant when O is transformed with the mapping

metrics.name: distance_from_sentinel_sequence
metrics.definition: Hamming distance from 000 in canonical Voice order
metrics.invariance: coordinate-permutation invariant under the fixed-sentinel subgroup

gf2VectorSpace.fanoFirewall: nonzero-vector incidence may be reported mathematically only; no semantic assignment

operations: weights relative to a chosen origin

mathematicalStructures.nonConflationRule: GF(2)^3 linear equivalence and Q3 graph equivalence are reported separately

primaryQuestion: DOES STRUCTURAL_V0_1 PROVIDE STRUCTURAL INFORMATION NOT ALREADY DETERMINED BY THE CANONICAL ORDER/RING/MIRROR GEOMETRY?

primaryMetric.name: ADDITIONAL_STRUCTURAL_INVARIANT_COUNT
primaryMetric.transformation: derive only the listed binary signatures, compare candidate and control equivalence classes, and exclude by-construction and symmetry-only distinctions
primaryMetric.control: EXACT_RING_PRESERVING plus CENTERED_MIRROR_EDGE and UNRESTRICTED context
primaryMetric.output: count of preregistered nontrivial binary invariants surviving the applicable symmetry/control test
primaryMetric.decisionRule: zero surviving invariants is REDUNDANT; raw distinctions that disappear under the applicable symmetry are PARTIALLY_ADDITIVE; at least one invariant that survives the symmetry/control test is ADDITIVE; failed required structure is LOSSY; invalid definitions or serialization are INVALID_EXPERIMENT

classificationRules.REDUNDANT: required canonical structure is preserved and no nontrivial binary invariant survives the preregistered control and symmetry tests
classificationRules.PARTIALLY_ADDITIVE: an apparent extra relation exists in a raw fixed-label representation but disappears under the applicable symmetry or is only an encoding-orientation distinction
classificationRules.ADDITIVE: at least one preregistered nontrivial binary invariant survives the applicable symmetry/control test and is not determined by canonical order/ring/mirror
classificationRules.LOSSY: the mapping or representation fails to preserve any required canonical Voice, ring, or mirror property
classificationRules.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: mapping space, control predicates, metric serialization, symmetry definitions, or preregistration integrity are invalid

falsificationRules: required canonical ring or mirror structure not preserved => LOSSY
all apparent binary structure is by construction or symmetry-equivalent to canonical geometry => REDUNDANT
claimed additional invariant disappears under equivalent bit relabeling or cube automorphism => not ADDITIVE
metric cannot distinguish the candidate from its relevant control family => no positive result under that metric
semantic interpretation is required => outside V0.1
effect appears only in selected mappings and not exhaustive controls => no additive structural claim
invalid family or metric definitions => INVALID_EXPERIMENT and repair preregistration before execution

reproducibility.enumerationOrder: canonical Voice order A,E,I,O,U,Y,Ë; assign lexicographically ordered nonzero codes 001,010,011,100,101,110,111 by permutation order
reproducibility.metricSerialization: canonical Voice order, upper-triangular pairs where applicable, pipe-delimited binary strings, comma-delimited numeric sequences
reproducibility.numericComparison: exact integer comparison; no floating point
reproducibility.tieHandling: equal serialized signatures are one equivalence class
